## Recommended next actions (in order)

```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --run --select-best
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml --run
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

### What each one will do (so you know what to look for)
1) **`aub_autopilot.py ... --select-best`**
   - Runs module-level candidates from the module registry.
   - Selects the best-performing module config relative to the current champion.
   - What to capture for me: which candidate (if any) was promoted, and the updated metrics.

2) **`system_autopilot.py ... --run`**
   - Runs system-level candidates (end-to-end variations) from `system_candidates.yaml`.
   - What to capture: any candidate that beats the champion on your gating criteria (often lockbox_mean first), plus the leaderboard summary.

3) **`aub_next_fix.py ... next_fix.md`**
   - Generates a “next fix” report—usually pointing at the weakest areas/regressions or highest ROI fix.
   - What to capture: the contents (or at least the top sections) of `baseline/reports/next_fix.md`.

## Send me back one of these
To proceed efficiently, paste either:
- The **terminal output** from all three commands, or
- The paths to generated reports + the key summary lines (best candidate, deltas, pass/fail).

If you tell me your exact promotion rule (e.g., “must improve lockbox_mean and not regress tuning_mean by >X”), I can also help decide whether to accept/promote borderline improvements.
